title: Boolean Lattices, Power Sets and Divisor Lattices
quickIdea: A Boolean lattice is a complemented distributive lattice, and the power set lattice is the model for all of them. The divisor lattice of n is Boolean exactly when n is squarefree.
remember: A Boolean lattice is a lattice that is bounded, complemented and distributive. Meet is AND, join is OR, complement is NOT - the same three operations as Boolean algebra.
The power set of an n-element set, ordered by inclusion, is a Boolean lattice with 2^n elements; its atoms are the singletons, and A' is the set complement of A.
The number of elements of the Boolean lattice B_n is 2^n, and the number of its covering pairs is n times 2^(n-1) - each subset is covered by adding one element.
The divisor lattice D_n ordered by divisibility has join lcm and meet gcd. It is Boolean exactly when n is squarefree, and then it has 2^(number of primes) elements.
D_6 = {1, 2, 3, 6} is the 4-element Boolean lattice. D_12 is a lattice but not Boolean, because 2 has no complement.

The functions from {1, ..., n} to {0, 1} under the pointwise order form a Boolean lattice isomorphic to B_n, with join the pointwise maximum and meet the pointwise minimum - the shape of GATE CSE 2025 Set 2 Q.32.
Every finite Boolean lattice is isomorphic to a power set lattice, so counting subsets answers every question about it.

example.prompt: How many elements and how many covering pairs does the Boolean lattice B_4 have, and what is the complement of {1, 2}?
example.work: B_4 is the power set of a 4-element set, so 2^4 = 16 elements. Covering pairs: each of the 16 subsets is covered by adding one of the missing elements, and summing the missing elements over all subsets gives 4 times 2^3 = 32. The complement of {1, 2} is {3, 4}.

gateAngle: GATE CSE 2025 Set 2 Q.32 turned the pointwise order on {0,1}-valued functions into a Boolean lattice question: the relation is a partial order and a lattice, with join max and meet min. Recognising the shape as B_n answers 'is it a lattice' and 'is it distributive' in one step.

variations.label: VERIFIED PYQ
variations.question: GATE CSE 2025 Set 2 Q.32: F is the set of all functions from {1, ..., n} to {0, 1}, and f <= g when f(x) <= g(x) for every x. Which are true? (A) <= is symmetric (B) (F, <=) is a partial order (C) (F, <=) is a lattice (D) <= is an equivalence relation.
variations.why: Reflexive, antisymmetric and transitive give a partial order; join is the pointwise maximum and meet the pointwise minimum, both inside F, so it is a lattice - in fact the Boolean lattice B_n. Symmetry fails because 0 <= 1 but not 1 <= 0, which also kills (D).

variations.label: ORIGINAL PYQ-STYLE QUESTION
variations.question: Is the divisor lattice of 30 Boolean? How many elements does it have?
variations.answer: Yes. 30 = 2 x 3 x 5 is squarefree, so the lattice is Boolean with 2^3 = 8 elements.
variations.why: Each divisor is a subset of {2, 3, 5}, and divisibility becomes inclusion, so the lattice is the power set of a 3-element set.

variations.label: PREDICTED VARIATION
variations.question: In the Boolean lattice B3, how many elements lie strictly below the element {1, 2}?
variations.why: An element of B3 is a subset and the order is inclusion, so the elements below {1,2} are its subsets. A 2-element set has 2^2 = 4 subsets, one of which is itself.

trap.what: Assuming every complemented lattice is Boolean, or that every divisor lattice is Boolean.
trap.why: Boolean needs all three conditions. D_12 is distributive and bounded but not complemented; M3 is complemented and bounded but not distributive. Neither is Boolean.
trap.counterexample: D_12 = {1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12}: 2 has no complement, so it is not complemented, hence not Boolean - although it is distributive. M3 is complemented but not distributive, so it is not Boolean either.

check.question: How many elements does the Boolean lattice of the divisors of 210 have?
check.explanation: 210 = 2 x 3 x 5 x 7 has four distinct primes, so the divisor lattice is the power set of a 4-element set: 2^4 = 16 divisors, all of them squarefree.
